steps.instruction: Pay Helix Wholesale 11 units at 437.97 each (lowest unit price of the three vendors), total 4817.67 USD, memo 'purchase order'.
Set KV key order/vendor to the vendor name Helix Wholesale.
Set KV key order/total to 4817.67 (11 x 437.97, two decimals).

steps.content: # Order Summary. Vendor: Helix Wholesale. Unit price: 437.97 USD. Quantity: 11. Total: 4817.67 USD.
steps.instruction: Write orders/summary.md listing vendor, unit price, quantity and total as given in content.

steps.content: The order has been placed with vendor Helix Wholesale. Total amount: {order/total} USD.
steps.subject: Order confirmation
steps.instruction: Read KV key order/total and insert its value into the body in place of {order/total} before sending to the approving manager.
